purpose: Structured risk guidance only; never use this file as contract evidence.

risk_domains.description: Potential financial loss, penalties, fees, or uncapped monetary obligations.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern when exposure is fixed, escalating, uncapped, or supported by multiple clauses.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review caps, calculation mechanics, exclusions, notice, cure, and payment controls.

risk_domains.description: Potentially disproportionate or unlimited responsibility for losses, claims, or damages.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where caps, carve-outs, claim scope, or defense controls are absent or broad.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review cap structure, carve-outs, claim scope, defense control, and exclusions.

risk_domains.description: Potential operational or commercial disruption caused by termination rights or process.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where termination is immediate, unilateral, without cause, or lacks cure and transition controls.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review notice, cause, cure, transition, survival, and post-termination obligations.

risk_domains.description: Potential interruption, unclear performance, or inability to transition contractual operations.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where operational obligations are broad, unclear, or tied to suspension or termination.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review measurable obligations, remedies, transition support, and continuity controls.

risk_domains.description: Potential failure to meet legal, regulatory, audit, reporting, or policy obligations.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where obligations are mandatory, broad, uncapped, or lack verification and remediation.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review applicable laws, audit scope, records, notice, remediation, and allocation of responsibility.

risk_domains.description: Potential inability of insurance requirements to support contractual exposure.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where coverage, limits, policy duration, proof, or additional-insured requirements are unclear.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review policy types, limits, duration, certificates, additional insured status, and notice of cancellation.

risk_domains.description: Potential loss of control, ownership, or clarity over intellectual property rights.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where rights are broad, perpetual, exclusive, transferable, or unclear in subject matter.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review subject matter, scope, territory, duration, exclusivity, ownership, and sublicensing.

risk_domains.description: Potential inability to transfer, reorganize, or control contractual rights and obligations.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where consent is broad, unilateral, unclear, or triggered by ordinary corporate events.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review permitted transfers, affiliates, control changes, consent standards, and termination consequences.

risk_domains.description: Potential uncertainty or cost in enforcing rights and resolving disputes.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where forum, rules, seat, costs, notice, or governing law are unclear or conflicting.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review forum, seat, rules, governing law, escalation, confidentiality, and cost allocation.

risk_domains.description: Potential restriction or imbalance affecting commercial flexibility and economics.
risk_domains.severity_guidance: Increase concern where commitments are fixed, automatic, exclusive, or difficult to exit.
risk_domains.mitigation_guidance: Review scope, duration, minimums, adjustment rights, renewal notice, and exit mechanics.
